items.title: The Umbrella Share Box
items.topic: a station project where commuters could borrow umbrellas on rainy days
items.action: helped label donated umbrellas and record simple return instructions
items.benefit: travelers caught in sudden rain could stay dry without buying a new umbrella
items.challenge: some umbrellas were returned to different exits and became hard to find
items.lesson: a shared service works better when return points are easy to recognize
items.detail: volunteers added bright signs beside each collection box
items.reflection: Hana learned that clear directions can make a kind idea easier for everyone to use
items.topicJa: 雨の日に通勤客が傘を借りられる駅の取り組み
items.benefitJa: 急な雨でも新しい傘を買わずに濡れずに移動できること
items.challengeJa: 別の出口に返されて傘を見つけにくくなること
items.lessonJa: 返却場所を分かりやすくすると共有サービスは使いやすくなる

items.title: A Classroom Plant Team
items.topic: students taking turns caring for plants in their classroom
items.action: made a weekly chart for watering and checking sunlight
items.benefit: the plants stayed healthy while students learned responsibility
items.challenge: different plants needed different amounts of water
items.lesson: good care begins with noticing that not everything needs the same treatment
items.detail: students placed small care cards beside each pot
items.reflection: Kai saw that simple observation was more useful than following one rule for every plant
items.topicJa: 教室の植物を交代で世話する生徒たち
items.benefitJa: 植物を元気に保ちながら責任感を学べること
items.challengeJa: 植物ごとに必要な水の量が違うこと
items.lessonJa: 良い世話には一律の方法ではなく違いを観察することが大切

items.title: The Saturday Toy Exchange
items.topic: a neighborhood event where families exchanged toys their children no longer used
items.action: sorted toys by age and checked that small parts were safely packed
items.benefit: families found new toys without spending much money or throwing useful items away
items.challenge: some donated toys were missing pieces or instructions
items.lesson: checking shared items before passing them on protects both usefulness and trust
items.detail: a table was prepared for incomplete toys that could still be repaired
items.reflection: Sora learned that reuse requires care as well as generosity
items.titleJa: 土曜日のおもちゃ交換会
items.topicJa: 使わなくなったおもちゃを家族同士で交換する地域イベント
items.benefitJa: 費用を抑えながら使える物を捨てずに次の家庭へ渡せること
items.challengeJa: 部品や説明書が足りないおもちゃがあること
items.lessonJa: 共有品を渡す前の確認が使いやすさと信頼を守る

items.title: A Safer Walk to School
items.topic: students mapping places that felt difficult or unsafe on the route to school
items.action: walked common routes with teachers and marked narrow crossings and blocked views
items.benefit: the map helped families discuss safer choices and report problems clearly
items.challenge: a place that felt safe in daylight could feel different in heavy traffic
items.lesson: safety improves when people observe conditions at more than one time
items.detail: the group repeated the walk during the morning rush
items.reflection: Ren learned that one quick look does not always show the whole situation
items.topicJa: 通学路で危険を感じる場所を生徒が地図にする活動
items.benefitJa: 家族が安全な道を話し合い問題を具体的に伝えられること
items.challengeJa: 昼間は安全に見える場所も交通量が多い時間には状況が変わること
items.lessonJa: 複数の時間帯で観察すると安全性をより正確に考えられる
